visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ list of expandable question/answer rows with an Expand all control
visualCharacteristics.description: New variant (no existing accordion variants in project): Bordered rows with chevron toggles and an Expand all control Page background, centered intro, accordion list, two buttons below.

reuseGuidance: Reuse for any FAQ or expandable list; the Expand all control appears when there are 2+ items.
